description: Find a book in the Siftivo catalog by its title or author, or by words from what it is about, and get the workId the other Siftivo tools take. Suits a named book ("add Circe to my list", "what is Babel about", "is Demon Copperhead worth reading") and the book behind a half-remembered plot ("the novel about a man alone in an endless house of statues").
name: search_books
title: Search books
